criterion: results/api_sweep_report.csv exists, is valid CSV with header name,env_var,base_url,health_status,probe_route,probe_status,records,ok, and contains a row for a large majority of the 101 target services.
The agent resolved each base URL from the environment variable named in api_targets.csv (e.g. $GITHUB_API_URL) rather than hardcoding hosts, and called <base_url>/health for the services it covered.
